description: Diagnose a failing command, error, exception, stack trace or failing test, and return a root cause plus ranked fixes. Call it the moment something fails, INCLUDING when you caused the failure yourself: a build or typecheck exiting non-zero (tsc, cargo, go build, mvn, dotnet), a linter reporting errors, a test suite going red, a script exiting non-zero, a runtime throwing, or the user pasting a traceback. Do not wait to be asked and do not skip it because you think you already know the fix: it answers from this project history, which is not derivable from the code in front of you, and a reported outcome on a known error is what makes the next answer better. Works for Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, C#, and more. Also takes a bug with NO error message: describe what you expected, what happened instead, and the code in between, and it is analysed like any other error. Pass the raw error text — this server runs locally and reads the source files the stack trace names, so you do not need to locate and paste the code first. Returns root cause plus up to 3 ranked fixes. Where an edit can be derived honestly a fix carries one, naming the file it belongs to; a fix that cannot be expressed as an exact replacement carries none rather than a guess, so read the root cause and write it yourself. Then call report_outcome.

codeSnippet.description: Optional. Surrounding code near where the error was thrown. Usually unnecessary — the server reads the files the trace names off local disk. Supply it only when the relevant code is somewhere the trace does not name; it overrides the local read.

errorText.description: The full error message, exception, or stack trace text.

expected.description: What reproCommand should print or do once the bug is fixed. Used with reproCommand.

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the file that threw the error, if known. An ABSOLUTE path also tells DebugAI which repository the error belongs to.

language.description: Source language hint, one of: javascript, typescript, python, go, rust, java, csharp, cpp, c, php, ruby, kotlin, swift, lua, shell, powershell, sql, html, css, scala, dart, elixir, r, perl. Leave it at "auto" (the default) unless you have a reason: the server reads the error text and the client cannot see it more clearly than that. A name outside the list is not an error, it is treated as "auto".

projectRoot.description: Absolute path of the repository this error came from. Pass it when you were started somewhere other than that repository: project memory and local file reads are scoped to it (never your home directory, a folder above it or the filesystem root), and without it they are scoped to the folder this server started in.

reproCommand.description: The command that reproduces the failure, if you have one: a test, a script, a curl. DebugAI does not run it. Fix #1 is aimed at making it pass, and every fix's check becomes "run this, expect that" instead of a syntax check. Pass it whenever you can.

snippetStartLine.description: Optional, with codeSnippet. The line of the file that the FIRST line of codeSnippet is. Pass it when the snippet is a window from the middle of a file: without it the lines are counted from 1, and a line number in the error will not match them.

name: debug_error
title: Debug Error
